svg.aria-label: Scenario 7, the institution wants it in Word. Operator's setup: tool and plugin names are overlay matters, not part of the canonical specs. You ask: The institution wants it in Word. In your session: step 1, /research-master:paper-writer in document mode, DECISION_012, drafts from the project's state files, the design of record, and hands you the filled document in the template's own format plus a source note; it never sends anything: you read every outward document in full before it leaves. Its rules for this case: rail (a), template sentences are copied verbatim and only the template's own fields, its bracketed or blank slots, change, with no section or table the template lacks; a field the state files cannot fill is left blank and listed as a question for you, never filled by guess. Step 2, the docx skill, the fill tool named in the overlay: a .docx is a ZIP archive of XML files; the template is an existing document, so it is edited: unzip; strip symlink entries, because docx from external parties is untrusted; merge fragmented runs; edit word/document.xml in place, do NOT reformat or pretty-print; zip; validate with XSD checks against the original. Step 3, render it and look at it: soffice converts to PDF, pdftoppm makes page images, then the images are read. Step 4, the last step, you read it in full: the result is handed to you for a full read, rail (f); the role never sends. Where the session runs: Claude Code in the terminal, here your session for steps 1 to 3 — use the CLI when you need scripting, automation, or prefer a terminal workflow; the /desktop command moves it into the Claude desktop app, then the CLI exits; in the desktop app Claude Code is the Code tab, and /desktop saves your session and opens it there; use Desktop when you want to review changes visually; /desktop is available on macOS and x64 Windows when signed in with a Claude subscription. Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop, fetched 2026-11-03; which surface runs which step was left to Claude by the operator, in chat 2026-11-03. Footnote, rail (f) of core/roles/paper-writer.md, lines 76 to 77: The operator reads every outward document in full before it leaves — this role never sends anything.
